drawings.description: en marge gauche du second post-scriptum, un croquis : deux traits horizontaux superposés, précédés chacun d'une accolade et d'une lettre, « $Y$ » en haut et « $X$ » en bas ; un point isolé au-dessus du trait de $Y$ ; à gauche, une flèche verticale descendante de $Y$ vers $X$.
drawings.kind: two lines one above the other, with an isolated point (the affine line with a disjoint point, over the affine line)
drawings.notes: As on the page: the two horizontal lines, each preceded by a brace and its letter (Y above, X below), the isolated point above the line of Y, and the short downward arrow at the left, between the two letters. Nothing struck. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: le dessin « ci-contre », en bas à gauche : un axe horizontal $p$ et un axe vertical $q$, fléchés ; une bande verticale hachurée de largeur $d$, à gauche de l'axe des $q$ et appuyée sur lui, commence à la hauteur $a$ au-dessus de l'axe des $p$ et monte ; la hauteur $a$ et la largeur $d$ sont cotées par des flèches doubles.
drawings.kind: hatched vertical band in the (p, q) plane (support of E_2^{pq})
drawings.notes: As on the page: the p-axis and the q-axis with their arrowheads and letters; the band between the q-axis and a parallel line at its left, closed below at height a and open above, hatched obliquely; the double arrow marked a from the p-axis up to the foot of the band, at the right of the q-axis; the double arrow marked d under the p-axis, spanning the width of the band. The band's lower edge, its left side and the axis are drawn between the same points. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: feuillet de croquis : trois diagrammes et quelques lignes, sans titre
drawings.notes: Top: A_0 B_0 and A B each joined by two oblique strokes to S_0 and S; S_0 -> T_0', S <-> T', S_0 -> T_0, T_0' -> T_0, S - Spec k = T, T' -> T, and "Z - T_0 ---- Spec k = T" along the bottom; A_x -> B_x at the top right. Then the lines A_{0 T_0'} -> B_{0 T_0'} and "A B   A_T -> B_T". Below: S <- T, upward arrows from S' -> T', and double upward arrows from S'' -> T''. The text block at the lower right is left out. Omitted as struck: the word scribbled out over the double arrow S <-> T'. Issue 128, 2026-11-09: struck material left out after a fresh check of the facsimile (struck-out material is not drawn). Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: croquis au crayon, au-dessus du trait : un $X'$ biffé d'où partent deux flèches vers $Y$, trois $\Omega$ dont un biffé, et un mot illisible sous le trait
drawings.kind: pencil sketch above a line: X' struck, arrows, Omegas, diagonal strokes
drawings.notes: Pencil, redrawn on tight crops. Top left: the square Y~ - X~ over Y - X with two downward arrows. Top centre: the heavily overwritten letter at the source of the two arrows (the struck X' of the transcription; on the facsimile it reads X rather than X', the prime being on the letter written above it) is left out as struck; a small hooked stroke goes from it up to X' (with its prime), and the two arrows go right towards Y. Two short pencil strokes and a small S-shaped stroke below them (unread) are drawn. Three long diagonal strokes down to the horizontal line (the first crosses it, the second stops at the illegible word just above it, the third stops just above it); the strokes are slightly concave and drawn as smooth curves, Omega^1 and Omega^1_{X'/Y'} (preceded by a dash; the struck symbol before the dash is left out) beside the second stroke, Omega^1_{X/Y} lower left. Left out: the illegible word (it sits just above the line, at the foot of the second diagonal, not under it), the typed text showing through from the back. Still a reading: the letters of Omega^1_{X'/Y'} and the role of the struck letter. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again. Question settled by a machine pass on the facsimile, 2026-11-12 (page): the illegible word stands just above the horizontal line, at the foot of the second diagonal stroke, as drawn (the transcription's « sous le trait » is to be corrected to « au-dessus du trait » by the transcription skill). Not checked by a reader. Question settled by a machine pass on the facsimile, 2026-11-12 (page): no consequence: whether the struck letter under the X' is X or X', it is struck and not drawn; the figure is the same. Not checked by a reader.

drawings.description: croquis en marge de gauche, sans pointes ; au-dessus, « $V$ » et « $U$ ? »
drawings.kind: square Y' - X', Y - X without arrowheads
drawings.notes: Y' - X' over Y - X joined by plain strokes (no heads), with V above Y' and "U ?" above X'.

drawings.description: à droite, trois croquis : en haut, une boîte en perspective faite de feuillets empilés, avec un point au milieu de sa face avant ; en bas à gauche, un cercle pointé ; en bas à droite, une seconde figure en perspective : une arête oblique dont chaque extrémité porte un éventail de traits, et un côté droit épaissi.
drawings.kind: two boxes in perspective and a pointed circle
drawings.notes: Three free-hand ink sketches, redrawn stroke by stroke. Top: a box in perspective: its left edge, its bottom edge, four nearly parallel strokes across its front (the top edge and three lines below it, like stacked sheets), a short top back edge, two verticals at the right and a short oblique stroke at the upper right corner; a heavy point in the middle of the front. Lower left: a circle with a point at its centre. Lower right: an oblique edge between two vertices; from the upper vertex strokes to the upper left, to the left, to the upper right (thin) and to the right down to a heavy right side; from the lower vertex strokes to the left, to the lower left (heavy), to the lower right (joining the foot of the heavy side) and a thin one to the upper right. Left out: the long pencil line that runs obliquely across the sheet (a separator), and a faint mark beside the upper vertex of the lower figure. Still differs: what solid each sketch shows is not clear (the note of the transcription says « deux boîtes en perspective »); the strokes are drawn as read, without completing them into a solid. The pointed circle is not mentioned by the note. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: croquis à gauche, encre sur crayon : deux disques l'un au-dessus de l'autre, $X'$ en haut et $X''$ en bas ; dans chacun, des traits rayonnent d'un centre marqué, avec les lettres $Z'_0$, $Z'$ (en haut) et $Z''_0$, $Z''$ (en bas), et un trait épais sort du disque vers la gauche jusqu'à une légende ($V(f')$, $V(f'')$, lecture incertaine) ; à droite une grande courbe $D$ entoure les deux disques, et deux flèches partent de la région de $D$ vers l'intérieur de chaque disque ; le disque du bas est doublé d'un second contour marqué $X''$.
drawings.kind: two discs X' and X'' with rays from their centres, joined by a curve D
drawings.notes: The two discs (drawn as ellipses fitted to his outlines), each with its marked centre and the strokes radiating from it, all drawn from the one centre: in the upper disc six strokes, the upper left one heavy and running out of the disc to the legend at the left, the lower right one heavy; in the lower disc four strokes, the left one heavy and running out of the disc to a small heavy triangle of strokes at the left. The letters Z'_0, Z' and Z''_0, Z'' inside the discs and X', X'' beside them, where he wrote them. The large curve D, open at the top left and at the bottom left, passing at the right of both discs, with its letter. The two arrows from the region of D into the discs (to the upper disc from the right, to the lower disc from the upper right), and the short heavy stroke beside their tails. The second outline round the lower disc, from its upper left over the top to the right. Left out: the two legends at the far left (read V(f') and V(f'') with doubt; overwritten), a struck blot above the lower legend, the second « X'' » and the words of the text at the right of the crop. Still differs: free strokes read on a crowded sketch; the number of rays in each disc and the exact course of D are approximate. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.
